verdict.rationale: Unity's docs and build system explicitly support multi-platform export (25+ platforms, build profiles, WebGL, mobile, desktop) and community evidence corroborates strong cross-platform/iOS build capability, though console export is typically handled via Unity's console partner programs rather than direct self-serve builds. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of console (PlayStation/Xbox/Switch) build pipelines and partner-program mechanics, and independent hands-on confirmation of console export specifically.
